ParentProfile.title: ParentProfile
ParentProfile.description: Registered parent or guardian account profile and assigned student summary.

parentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registered parent.

email.description: Verified email address of the parent.

childName.description: Student full name or first name.

assignedTutor.description: Lead BrightPath home tutor assigned to the student.

assignedTutorUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID of the assigned BrightPath tutor.

registeredAt.description: Server timestamp when the parent profile was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

StudentRoster.title: StudentRoster
StudentRoster.description: Non-PII student roster record enabling assigned tutors to manage session logs and reports without reading parent email addresses.

studentId.description: Document ID matching the owning parent's Firebase Auth UID.

parentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning parent.

parentName.description: Display name of the parent or guardian (no PII contact details).

assignedTutorUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID of the assigned tutor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student roster entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

TutorAccount.title: TutorAccount
TutorAccount.description: Coordinator-authorized BrightPath tutor account controlling access to the Tutor Dashboard.

tutorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized tutor.

specialty.description: Primary tutoring subjects and grade focus.

active.description: Whether this tutor currently has active dashboard access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when tutor access was granted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when tutor access was last updated.

ProgressReport.title: ProgressReport
ProgressReport.description: Academic progress report and tutor notes issued for a student under a registered parent account.

parentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning parent.

tutorUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID of the tutor who attached the report.

studentName.description: Name of the student evaluated in this report.

assessmentScore.description: Latest diagnostic or topic quiz score (0 to 100).

tutorName.description: Name of the BrightPath tutor authoring the note.

tutorNotes.description: Detailed tutor observations covering strengths, homework discipline, and mastery.

nextFocus.description: Planned next learning focus for upcoming home visits.

attachmentTitle.description: Optional label for an attached assessment sheet or study pack.

attachmentUrl.description: Optional HTTPS link to an external progress report PDF or study worksheet.

reportDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report.

status.description: Whether the parent has acknowledged the progress report.

parentReply.description: Optional short observation or acknowledgement reply from the parent.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was last updated.

SessionLog.title: SessionLog
SessionLog.description: Tutoring session log recording date, duration, attendance, topics covered, and homework assigned.

parentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning parent.

tutorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the tutor who logged the session.

sessionDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the home tutoring visit.

attendance.description: Attendance and completion status of the scheduled lesson.

topicsCovered.description: Key concepts and exercises worked through during the lesson.

homeworkAssigned.description: Practice tasks assigned before the next visit.

sessionNotes.description: Tutor remarks on concentration, pacing, and readiness.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session log was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session log was last updated.

/parents/{parentId}.description: Private parent profile documents containing parent email PII, strictly isolated to owning parent and coordinator.

/students/{studentId}.description: Non-PII student roster entries keyed by parentUid so assigned tutors can select students without reading parent emails.

/tutors/{tutorId}.description: Coordinator-managed registry of approved tutors allowed to use the Tutor Dashboard.

/parents/{parentId}/progressReports/{rep.description: Child progress reports and tutor notes scoped to the owning parent, assigned tutor, and coordinator.

/parents/{parentId}/sessionLogs/{logId}.description: Home tutoring session logs authored and updated by assigned tutors or coordinator for a specific student.
